capabilities.scope: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, a battery-powered normal POWER-on boot from NOR reached the ESP_MOSAICO kernel and a single-user shell with an FFS memory-disk root. This does not establish NAND boot, full PSRAM read/write or general peripheral support.
Vendor-firmware WebUI and a bounded live-log connection observed. No EmberBSD radio or sustained-transfer result.
Type-C USB-OTG ROM connection and complete 16 MiB NOR readback verified with esptool 5.6.0. This does not establish an EmberBSD USB console or a successful firmware restore.

On one V1.2 sample, factory firmware showed a visible UI and touch response; the changing camera preview is separate vendor-firmware evidence. EmberBSD raw touch contact/release and changing-coordinate events are confirmed. The normal CO5300 framebuffer/LVGL path remains black after the published SPI data-line mode fix, despite nonzero pixel buffers and zero SPI transfer errors; display acceptance remains unresolved. A separate reference-core diagnostic produced a solid red field inside the OS (result 0, no LVGL) through a temporary unpublished kernel adapter. This does not establish the normal framebuffer/genfb/LVGL path or identify the cause. The earlier U-Boot/kernel comparison preserves its historical register snapshot. Orientation, touch calibration and audio function remain unverified.

On one V1.2 sample, the left-slot camera EEPROM descriptor had valid CRCs and hardware-version field 0x0102. The factory firmware separately reported SC101IOT PID 0xda4a and rendered a changing 1280 × 720 UYVY preview. The optional EmberBSD identity-only driver read SC101IOT PID 0xda4a at 0x68 in a RAM trial. DVP capture is not implemented, so this does not establish an EmberBSD camera preview. The factory and EmberBSD results apply only to this sample and do not establish sensor identity for other modules.
